annotation.authors_or_issuer: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
key_provisions_or_claims: Signatories voluntarily commit to measures for developing and managing advanced generative AI systems.
Six outcomes: accountability, safety, fairness and equity, transparency, human oversight and monitoring, validity and robustness.
Additional measures for systems made widely available, including red-teaming and cybersecurity assessment.
Does not change existing legal obligations such as PIPEDA.
Signatories commit to support standards, information sharing, public awareness and inclusive, sustainable growth.
named_instruments_referenced: G7 Data Protection and Privacy Authorities Statement on Generative AI
annotation.summary_en: Canada's September 2023 voluntary code of conduct for developers and managers of advanced generative AI systems. Signatories commit to measures on accountability, safety, fairness, transparency, human oversight and robustness, with extra measures for widely available systems. It lists signatories and leaves existing legal obligations unchanged.
